name: StockOracle AI – Inventory Intelligence for WooCommerce
author: codefreex

sections.description:
StockOracle AI is a WooCommerce inventory management plugin for store owners who need better stock visibility, smarter reorder timing, and clearer demand planning inside WordPress. It analyzes product stock, sales velocity, days until stockout, reorder thresholds, and dead stock so you can act before inventory problems hurt sales.

If you are searching for WooCommerce inventory management, stock management, reorder alerts, demand forecasting, stockout prevention, or dead stock detection, StockOracle AI brings those workflows together in one admin experience.

The free plugin runs locally on your server. It does not require a subscription, does not send store data to Codefreex, and does not depend on any third-party API for its core inventory analytics.

Documentation & Upgrade

  • View Full Documentation
  • Upgrade to StockOracle AI Pro

Core WooCommerce Inventory Features

  • Inventory dashboard with a 0-100 inventory health score.
  • Inventory analysis table with product name, current stock, sales, velocity, stock status, and days until stockout.
  • Reorder alerts based on lead time, safety stock, and recent sales velocity.
  • Demand forecasting using local moving-average models built from WooCommerce order history.
  • Dead stock detection for products that have stopped moving.
  • ABC inventory classification support.
  • Stockout event tracking for recurring inventory issues.
  • CSV export for inventory review, supplier communication, and purchasing workflows.
  • HPOS-ready WooCommerce compatibility.

Why Store Owners Use StockOracle AI

  • Reduce stockouts by spotting reorder risk earlier.
  • Improve purchasing decisions with daily sales velocity and forecast data.
  • Find dead stock before it keeps tying up cash.
  • Review WooCommerce inventory health in one dashboard instead of multiple reports.
  • Export inventory data for operations, procurement, and spreadsheet workflows.

Free vs Pro

Free plugin includes:
* Inventory dashboard and health score
* Inventory analysis table
* Reorder alerts
* Dead stock detection
* Local demand forecasting
* ABC classification support
* CSV export
* Email alert digests

StockOracle AI Pro adds:
* AI demand forecasting with your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key
* Purchase orders
* Supplier management
* Multi-warehouse inventory
* Cash-flow and advanced analytics
* Scheduled HTML email reports
* License activation and update delivery

Upgrade to Pro

Take your analysis further with StockOracle AI Pro. Get access to:
* Advanced real-time data feeds.
* Exclusive AI prediction algorithms.
* Priority developer support.

Get StockOracle AI Pro today!

Privacy

StockOracle AI processes inventory analytics locally on your site. The free plugin does not send customer personal data, order details, or catalog analytics to Codefreex or an external AI provider.

The plugin creates its own analytics tables for cached summaries, stockout logs, and daily sales snapshots. These store inventory and sales aggregates only.

WooCommerce Compatibility

  • Supports WooCommerce HPOS.
  • Works with simple products and stock-managed variations.
  • Runs as an admin-focused inventory workflow with no storefront output.
  • Designed for modern WooCommerce inventory management on current WordPress releases.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the stockoracle-ai plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through the WordPress admin.
  3. Activate StockOracle AI.
  4. Go to StockOracle -> Settings and configure forecast period, analysis period, lead time, safety stock, and alerts.
  5. Open StockOracle -> Dashboard to review your WooCommerce inventory health and reorder signals.
sections.faq:
Does StockOracle AI require WooCommerce?

Yes. StockOracle AI is built specifically for WooCommerce inventory management and requires WooCommerce to be active.

Does the free plugin send data to external services?

No. The free plugin performs its inventory calculations on your own server and does not require an external API.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. StockOracle AI supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

What inventory data does it analyze?

It analyzes stock levels, sales history, sales velocity, reorder timing, stock status, and no-sales periods to produce forecasts, reorder alerts, and dead stock insights.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Stock-managed variations are included so you can review WooCommerce inventory at the SKU level.

What does the Pro version add?

Pro adds AI forecasting, purchase orders, supplier tools, multi-warehouse management, scheduled reports, and advanced inventory analytics.

Can I export my inventory data?

Yes. StockOracle AI includes CSV export for inventory analysis and operational reporting.

Where can I find setup help or documentation?

Full documentation is available here:
https://themefreex.com/docs/stockoracle-ai/

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

Plugin options, scheduled tasks, and plugin-owned tables are removed during uninstall. Your WooCommerce products and orders are not modified.
